section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Rear Suspension
title: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Rear Suspension

content.description: Illustration showing shock absorber connection to body with nuts and shaft held by screwdriver

items:
(a) Connect the shock absorber to the body with the nuts. Hold the shaft with a screwdriver.
Torque the nut.
Torque: 250 kg-cm (18 ft-lb, 25 N·m)

content.description: Illustration showing shock absorber connection to rear suspension arm with bolt

items:
(b) Connect the shock absorber to the rear suspension arm with the bolt. Torque the bolt.
Torque: 375 kg-cm (27 ft-lb, 37 N·m)

content.component: Shock absorber to rear suspension arm bolt

content.text: 6. CONNECT STABILIZER BAR END TO REAR SUSPENSION
Connect the cushion, retainer to the rear suspension arm with the nut. Torque the nut.
